payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and complete. All deterministic checks pass: split sizes match official sizes exactly (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), no subsampling, no duplicates, no blank images, no omitted artifacts, n_classes=9 and n_channels=3 are correct. The data profile correctly captures the known PathMNIST properties: (1) train/val are well-balanced (imbalance ratio 1.63) from a single-site random split; (2) the test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) from an external clinical center shows expected prevalence shifts (adipose ×1.79, debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56) and higher imbalance (3.95); (3) label ambiguity for 'debris', 'background', and stroma-vs-smooth-muscle is a genuine dataset limitation, not a pipeline error. The llm_model_digest being null for qwen3.8 via ollama is a minor reproducibility gap (model weights not pinned by hash) but does not affect the deterministic profiling results. One minor text inconsistency: the LLM-generated ambiguity_risks narrative references '96×96 patch resolution' while the structured data correctly reports image_shape_hwc=[28,28,3]; this is a narrative error only and does not affect any computed metric. Run manifest is consistent (seed=47, torch 2.14.0+cu126, medmnist 3.0.2, deterministic_torch=true). No blockers identified. Proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: Minor text inconsistency: LLM-generated ambiguity_risks narrative references '96×96 patch resolution' but actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; structured data is correct, narrative text is not.
